headlines.title: BlackRock, Inc. Reports Change in Voting Rights in Mercedes-Benz Group AG
headlines.line: BlackRock, Inc. has filed a regulatory notification regarding its voting rights in Mercedes-Benz Group AG, disclosing a total position of 5.98% as of November 11, 2026.

headlines.title: Klarna Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
headlines.line: Klarna Group plc announced its financial results for the third quarter of 2026, reporting $1.0 billion in revenue and positive adjusted operating income.

headlines.title: Bank of America Reports Normal Operations Amid Industry-Wide Banking Disruptions
headlines.line: Bank of America confirmed its systems were operating normally on November 17, 2026, following reports of technical issues at other major financial institutions.

headlines.title: The Home Depot Reports Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results and Updates Guidance
headlines.line: The Home Depot reported Q3 2026 sales of $43.4 billion and updated its full-year fiscal 2026 financial guidance.

headlines.title: Goldman Sachs Issues Gold Price Forecast for 2027
headlines.line: Goldman Sachs analysts project gold prices to reach $4,650 per troy ounce by the end of 2027.

headlines.title: Goldman Sachs Participates in Bajaj Finance Share Offering
headlines.line: Goldman Sachs, alongside BlackRock and Nomura, has invested in a share offering by Bajaj Finance.

headlines.title: The Home Depot Announces Executive Leadership Changes
headlines.line: The Home Depot has appointed Richard McPhail as CEO, Ann-Marie Campbell as President and COO, and Jordan Broggi as CFO, effective November 23, 2026.

headlines.title: Bank of America Customers Affected by Technical Disruption
headlines.line: Bank of America customers experienced service disruptions on Monday due to a software bug originating at JPMorgan Chase.

headlines.title: Berkshire Hathaway Reduces Stake in Bank of America
headlines.line: Berkshire Hathaway disclosed a reduction in its Bank of America position, selling 27.53 million shares during the third quarter.

headlines.title: YouGov Survey Data Cited in Chipotle Consumer Behavior Report
headlines.line: Chipotle Mexican Grill utilized YouGov survey data to support the launch of a new consumer product related to movie theater dining habits.

headlines.title: YouGov and Prospa Release Research on Australian SME Payment Preferences
headlines.line: YouGov and fintech company Prospa published joint research regarding the payment habits and rewards preferences of Australian small and medium-sized enterprises.

headlines.title: YouGov and ESA Publish 2026 Holiday Video Game Survey
headlines.line: YouGov and the Entertainment Software Association (ESA) released findings from a survey regarding holiday gift preferences for video games among children and teens.

headlines.title: UBS Downgrades Shoals Technologies Group to Neutral
headlines.line: UBS downgraded Shoals Technologies Group from "Buy" to "Neutral" with a price target of $9.

headlines.title: Morgan Stanley and Jefferies Update Nucor Analyst Ratings and Price Targets
headlines.line: Financial analysts at Morgan Stanley and Jefferies issued updated ratings and price targets for Nucor Corporation on November 17, 2026.

headlines.title: Pizza Hut Partners with Pepsi and Josh Allen for Marketing Campaign
headlines.line: Pizza Hut has launched a new marketing campaign featuring Pepsi and NFL player Josh Allen to promote its 'Triple Treat Box' holiday offering.

summary:
**Market summary, 2026-11-17 (data as of 13:33 UTC)**

In the previous session (2026-11-16), U.S. equities fell broadly. SPY dropped 1.91% and QQQ 2.67%, with XLK down 3.24%. IWM fell 1.66% and DIA 1.43%. Energy (XLE, -1.96%) and industrials (XLI, -1.85%) also declined, while staples (XLP, +0.27%) and utilities (XLU, +0.18%) edged higher. VIXY rose 9.03%. Gold (GLD) fell 0.71% and oil (USO) fell 3.81%.

Pre-market ETF moves were small, ranging from -0.94% (XLV) to +0.39% (QQQ). Individual pre-market moves are on thin volume and may not reflect real prices.

Economic data: the Empire State Manufacturing Index printed 7.80 against a 17.60 consensus. The 3-month bill auction yielded 4.155%, above the 4.099% consensus. Several Fed speakers are scheduled today.

Company headlines include Home Depot's Q3 sales of $43.4 billion and a CEO change effective November 23. Bank of America said its systems were operating normally after industry-wide disruptions.
